five: $U_{\rm enc}^{\dagger}EU_{\rm enc}$ = (logical Pauli on $q_0$) $\otimes$ (syndrome $s$ on $q_1$–$q_4$); a 16-entry lookup gives $P_{\rm corr}$; $q_0$ reads $Z_L$.
qaoa: $C=\sum_{(i,j)\in E}\tfrac12(1-Z_iZ_j)$: $e^{-i\gamma C}$ is one $R_{ZZ}(-\gamma)$ per edge (up to a global phase).
qft: $R_k=\mathrm{diag}(1,e^{2\pi i/2^k})$. The approximate QFT of degree $m$ keeps only the $R_k$ with $k\le m+1$.
qml: feature map $U_\Phi(\vec x)$ ($\times r$), trainable ansatz $W(\vec\theta)$; the model is $f(\vec x)=\langle Z\cdots Z\rangle$.
repetition: ancillas measure $Z_{d_0}Z_{d_1}$ and $Z_{d_1}Z_{d_2}$ each round; the logical bit is the majority of $d_0d_1d_2$.
shor: multiplications $\bmod 15$; the counting register reads $y\approx 2^t s/r$, and continued fractions give the order $r$.
surface: $[[4,1,2]]$: detects any single error, corrects none; ancillas $q_4,q_5,q_6$ measure the three checks.
zne_fold: global folding $U(U^{\dagger}U)^{k}$ multiplies the noise by $\lambda=1+2k$ and leaves the ideal result unchanged.
